description: Object identification (normalised edit-distance scores, hints, quests), point and name, examine and read sign (src/language-learning/world-words.ts).
comparison: exact, object key sets included (a key TypeScript leaves undefined is absent); an unknown op or step is an error, never a skip

cases.name: normalize: case, punctuation, accents and spaces are off; scores are half-up percents of edit distance
identify: prompts, a hint after two tries, close and far misses, a pass, the quest done
cases.note: Pass at 45. A miss at 30 or more is "Close!"; from the second try the feedback carries the hint, and so does the next prompt. An identified target prompts nothing and answers "Already identified.". A pass raises object_identified last (the world object manager's event, which identify_object objectives count), named by the target's objectName or else its id, with its category when it has one.

naming: a world's translated objects are nameable; three wrong tries reveal the word and stop pointing
cases.note: Objects without a translation in the target language, or without a role, are not nameable. An object is named by its role.
